subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Which requester identity may the macOS approval popup disclose: only a sanitized session label, structured channel/thread metadata, or raw sender/account identifiers as well?
rationale: The popup is a security decision surface, and session keys or requester fields can expose private channel, account, thread, or sender identifiers; source inspection cannot determine the intended privacy boundary.

options.title: Sanitized structured identity
options.body: Display a sanitized session label and authoritative channel/thread labels, while omitting raw sender IDs and clearly marking any non-authoritative reason text.

options.title: Session label only
options.body: Add only a sanitized Session row now and defer all new requester fields until a broader approval-identity policy is accepted.

options.title: Full requester metadata
options.body: Display raw channel, sender, account, thread, and reason fields, accepting the resulting privacy and spoofing considerations as intentional product behavior.

recommendation.title: Sanitized structured identity
recommendation.body: Display a sanitized session label and authoritative channel/thread labels, while omitting raw sender IDs and clearly marking any non-authoritative reason text.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing issue review from steipete explicitly preserved the item for this product and disclosure decision, making them the strongest available routing candidate.
